sentence: This project tests a light-activatable nanoplatform that delivers photodynamic therapy and chemotherapy to peritoneal metastasis.
This project builds an Earth-scale radio telescope from billions of everyday Internet of Things devices.
This project builds deep learning methods that use topology to analyze complex biomedical structures such as neurons and vessels.
This project supports a conference about modeling, estimation, and control of dynamical systems.
This project builds a learning program that helps cybersecurity analysts and engineers use data analytics together as a team.
This project connects botanical gardens to work on the conservation, genetics, and ecology of rare plants.
This project builds methods to study periodic orbits and topological entropy in Hamiltonian systems, using topological data analysis.
This project builds AI guidance that lets novice practitioners capture ultrasound images for diagnosing musculoskeletal injuries.
This project builds network telescopes that adjust which Internet traffic they capture, using programmable switches.
This project studies how hard it is to work out good approximations of the properties of quantum many-body systems.
This project works on the design, analysis, and use of algorithms, including for social networks, genetic analysis, and cancer treatment.
This project studies how atomic structure and chemical composition at interfaces in ceramic materials affect how ions move through them.
This project studies how dihydrouridine, a chemical change on mRNA, affects plants under drought and heat stress.
This project builds a shared cloud laboratory that uses robots and AI to run chemistry and materials experiments.
This project builds insect-scale robots that change shape to move through confined spaces.
This project studies how mutation, selection, and drift affect the stability of proteins, using rhinovirus as a model.
This project uses long-term data on mammals and plants to test how well forecasts of ecological change hold up as conditions change.
This project studies the singularities that arise in minimal hypersurfaces and mean curvature flow.
